scenarios.name: turns-the-face-down-target-up-and-pings-every-other-creature
scenarios.why: Choose target creature you control. Turn it face up if it's face down: Den Protector (cast megamorphed, not turned up for its megamorph cost, so no counter) becomes its printed 2/1, then deals 2 damage to each OTHER creature -- Grizzly Bears dies, Centaur Courser survives with 2 damage, and Den Protector's own face-up trigger returned Forest to hand.

scenarios.name: face-up-target-simply-pings
scenarios.why: Chosen creature is already face up: nothing is turned over, and it deals damage equal to its power to each other creature -- Grizzly Bears (2/2) kills the face-down Den Protector (2/2) while it stays on the battlefield.
